fields.details_en: New and migrated configurations use schema version 5.
fields.summary_ja: 設定スキーマのバージョン
fields.details_ja: 新規設定と移行済み設定で使用するバージョン5。

fields.details_en: Selects one registered scope model and its transport URI.
fields.details_ja: 登録済みモデルと通信URIの組み合わせ。

fields.details_en: The model must match an oscilloscope registered by the instruments crate.
fields.summary_ja: オシロスコープモデル
fields.details_ja: instruments crateに登録されたモデル名との一致。
constraints: must be a registered oscilloscope model

fields.details_en: DHO5108 normally uses direct TCP/IP and never uses a Prologix transport.
fields.summary_ja: オシロスコープの通信URI
fields.details_ja: DHO5108で使用するdirect TCP/IP。Prologix transport対象外。
constraints: transport must be supported by the model and build features

fields.details_en: Required only by commands that trigger or automate a measurement.
fields.summary_ja: 任意のファンクションジェネレータ設定
fields.details_ja: triggerまたは自動測定系commandで必要な装置設定。
constraints: required by trigger, autoshot, automeasure, and auto

fields.details_en: Required when the generator table is present.
fields.summary_ja: ファンクションジェネレータモデル
fields.details_ja: generator table使用時に必要な登録名。
constraints: must be a registered generator model

fields.details_en: The URI selects native GPIB or a Prologix TCP/serial controller.
fields.summary_ja: ファンクションジェネレータの通信URI
fields.details_ja: native GPIBまたはPrologix TCP/serialの選択。
constraints: transport must be supported by the model and build features

fields.details_en: Controls canonical waveform formats and optional screenshot capture.
fields.details_ja: 標準波形形式と任意のスクリーンショット取得の設定。

fields.details_en: Raw is preferred for very large captures; both also writes CSV.
fields.details_ja: 大規模取得向けraw、CSV併記向けboth。

fields.details_en: Auto selects available canonical data, preferring verified raw data.
fields.details_ja: 利用可能な標準データを選ぶauto。検証済みraw優先。

fields.details_en: Capture requires a scope and transport that support display transfer.
fields.summary_ja: オシロスコープ画面取得
fields.details_ja: display transfer対応モデル・通信方式での任意取得。
constraints: DHO5108 capture requires TCP/IP or USB-TMC

fields.details_en: Each entry assigns one channel and exactly one scaling strategy.
fields.summary_ja: センサーチャンネル一覧
fields.details_ja: 各channelと単一scale方針の対応。
constraints: channels must not overlap reference or lock-in signal channels

fields.details_en: The current DHO5108 mapping accepts channels 1 through 8.
fields.summary_ja: センサーチャンネル番号
fields.details_ja: DHO5108向け1以上8以下の番号。
constraints: must be unique across all channel roles

fields.details_en: Choose direct multiplication or maximum-absolute normalization.
fields.details_ja: 直接係数または最大絶対値正規化の択一。
constraints: factor and max_abs forms are mutually exclusive

fields.details_en: Multiplies the integrated sensor values directly.
fields.summary_ja: 線形センサー変換係数
fields.details_ja: 積分センサー値への直接乗算。

fields.details_en: Normalizes the measured absolute maximum to this positive target.
fields.summary_ja: 最大絶対値の正規化目標
fields.details_ja: 測定最大絶対値に対応する正の目標値。

fields.details_en: Required with max_abs scaling.
fields.summary_ja: 最大絶対値正規化の極性
fields.details_ja: max_abs使用時の必須符号。

fields.details_en: Matplotlib mathtext may be supplied as a TOML literal string.
fields.summary_ja: センサープロットラベル
fields.details_ja: TOML literal stringで指定可能なMatplotlib mathtext。

fields.summary_en: Output unit for the scaled sensor.
fields.details_en: Used in tables, plots, and saved analysis headers.
fields.summary_ja: 変換後センサーの出力単位
fields.details_ja: 表・プロット・解析保存headerでの単位。

fields.details_en: Defines baseline regions before and after the pulse.
fields.details_ja: パルス前後のベースライン領域。

fields.details_en: An inline table with finite start and end values.
fields.details_ja: 有限なstartとendのinline table。

fields.details_en: An inline table with finite start and end values.
fields.details_ja: 有限なstartとendのinline table。

fields.details_en: Controls the channel that records the function-generator sine wave sent to the EOM, the FFT region, and fit decimation.
fields.summary_ja: EOM駆動用正弦波の解析設定
fields.details_ja: EOMへ入力するファンクションジェネレータ正弦波の記録チャンネル、FFT区間、fit間引きを指定。

fields.details_en: The current DHO5108 mapping accepts channels 1 through 8; assign the function-generator sine wave sent to the EOM.
fields.summary_ja: EOM駆動信号の記録チャンネル
fields.details_ja: EOMへ入力するファンクションジェネレータ正弦波を記録するDHO5108の1以上8以下のチャンネル。
constraints: must be unique across all channel roles

fields.summary_en: Time range used by the EOM-drive FFT.
fields.details_en: Choose a stable segment of the recorded sine wave with finite start and end values.
fields.details_ja: 記録した正弦波の安定区間を表す有限なstartとend。

fields.details_en: Larger values reduce fitting cost at the expense of temporal detail.
fields.summary_ja: EOM駆動正弦波fitの間引き幅
fields.details_ja: 計算量と時間分解能の調整値。

fields.details_en: Used around the FFT estimate by EOM-drive signal analysis.
fields.summary_ja: 局所EOM駆動正弦波fitの窓幅
fields.details_ja: FFT推定値周辺で使用するsample数。

fields.details_en: Defines signal channels, parallelism, output stride, and low-pass filtering.
fields.details_ja: 信号channel、並列度、出力間引き、low-pass filterの指定。

fields.details_en: At least one channel is required by lock-in and downstream analysis.
fields.summary_ja: lock-in 復調対象チャンネル
fields.details_ja: lock-inと後段解析で必要な1件以上のchannel番号。
constraints: must be unique across all channel roles

fields.details_en: Values near the physical CPU count are a practical starting point.
fields.details_ja: 物理CPU数付近を初期値とする並列度。

fields.summary_en: Lock-in output stride in input samples.
fields.details_en: Input sample rate divided by this value gives the output sample rate.
fields.details_ja: 入力sample rateを割るsample数。出力sample rateを決定。

fields.details_en: The current runtime accepts the boxcar_legacy kind; fields from other kinds are not part of schema v5.
fields.details_ja: schema v5ではboxcar_legacyのみを使用。
constraints: fields from other filter kinds are rejected

fields.details_en: boxcar_legacy is the only active LPF. Historical FIR and IIR kinds are readable only for migration diagnostics.
fields.summary_ja: lock-in filter アルゴリズム
fields.details_ja: 現在のLPFはboxcar_legacyのみ。過去のFIR/IIR kindは移行診断のためだけに読み取る。

fields.details_en: The boxcar integration window extends symmetrically by this many reference cycles.
fields.summary_ja: 参照周期単位の半窓幅
fields.details_ja: boxcar積分窓を参照周期単位で指定する半窓幅。

fields.details_en: Enable only for filter inspection because artifacts can be large.
fields.details_ja: filter調査時のみ有効化する大容量artifact出力。

fields.details_en: The label is restricted to a short ASCII filename-safe subset.
fields.details_ja: 短いASCII filename-safe文字列。

fields.details_en: Allows replacement of an existing matching debug output.
fields.details_ja: 同名debug出力の置換許可。

fields.summary_en: Optional background window for SNR diagnostics.
fields.details_en: An inline table with finite start and end values.
fields.details_ja: 有限なstartとendの任意inline table。

fields.summary_en: Optional signal window for SNR diagnostics.
fields.details_en: An inline table with finite start and end values.
fields.details_ja: 有限なstartとendの任意inline table。

fields.details_en: Writes NPY artifacts in addition to canonical CSV results.
fields.details_ja: 標準CSVに追加するNPY artifact。

fields.details_en: Contains offsets for the first six harmonic components.
fields.details_ja: 第1から第6高調波のoffset。

fields.details_en: Numeric expressions such as pi/2 are accepted.
fields.details_ja: pi/2などの数式指定に対応するrad値。

fields.details_en: Specifies the calibration sensor, calculation method, and final factor.
fields.details_ja: 校正用センサー、計算方法、最終係数を指定。

fields.summary_en: Sensor channel used for Kerr-angle calibration.
fields.details_en: The channel must also exist in the sensors array.
fields.summary_ja: Kerr角度の校正に使用するセンサーチャンネル
fields.details_ja: sensors配列に存在するチャンネルを指定。

fields.details_en: Selects the standard or harmonics-based analysis implementation.
fields.details_ja: standardまたはharmonics実装を選択。

fields.details_en: Applied after the selected Kerr-angle calculation.
fields.details_ja: 選択したKerr角度計算後に乗算する値。

fields.details_en: Controls display/save behavior, decimation, and error policy.
fields.details_ja: 表示・保存、間引き、失敗方針の指定。

fields.details_en: Batch use normally selects save; interactive opens Matplotlib windows.
fields.details_ja: batch向けsaveとMatplotlib window向けinteractive。

fields.details_en: Lower values improve Matplotlib responsiveness on large captures.
fields.summary_ja: プロット入力の最大点数
fields.details_ja: 大規模取得時のMatplotlib応答性調整値。

fields.details_en: min_max preserves narrow extrema better than stride decimation.
fields.summary_ja: プロット間引きアルゴリズム
fields.details_ja: 狭い極値の保持に適したmin_max。

fields.details_en: Warn preserves successful analysis; fail makes plotting errors fatal.
fields.details_ja: 解析成功を保持するwarnと致命扱いのfail。

fields.details_en: Version 5 accepts but ignores this field; artifacts use the canonical run layout.
fields.details_ja: version 5で受理後に無視される値。artifactは標準run layout。
